tree.text: the term “child” means an individual under the age of 18 years; and
the term “abuse” means physical or mental injury, sexual abuse or exploitation, or negligent treatment of a child.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 3796aa–8 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: GRANTS FOR CLOSED-CIRCUIT TELEVISING OF TESTIMONY OF CHILDREN WHO ARE VICTIMS OF ABUSE
